section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section discusses the findings of the first research exploring gratitude's effect on loneliness and well-being in an older population. It suggests that a gratitude writing exercise can alleviate loneliness and its negative outcomes, with the treatment group showing stronger indirect effects of loneliness on gratitude-health associations compared to the control group. The exercise is presented as a simple, easily teachable intervention for older individuals.
